name: Empirical Bayes selection of wavelet thresholds
model_likelihood: Noisy regularly spaced function observations; levelwise standardized independent Gaussian sequence Z_i ~ N(mu_i,1).
prior: Independent (1-w_j) delta_0 + w_j gamma_j mixtures with heavy-tailed Laplace or quasi-Cauchy slabs.
inference_algorithm: Levelwise constrained marginal maximum likelihood for w_j and optional slab scale; plug-in posterior median; optional translation-invariant average marginal likelihood.
estimand: Thresholded coefficientwise posterior medians and inverse-wavelet function estimates.
data_input: Regular-grid noisy function measurements and their discrete wavelet coefficients.
tunable_settings: Wavelet family; coarse level L; Laplace or quasi-Cauchy slab; fixed or fitted slab scale; posterior median or alternative bounded-shrinkage rule; derivative threshold modification A; conventional or translation-invariant transform.
